description:
TikTok Hashtag Scraper — Fast Video, Creator & Metrics

High-speed TikTok hashtag scraper. Extract videos, views, likes, comments, shares, audio details, and creator profiles by hashtag at an ultra-competitive price.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Video: $0.001.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/tiktok-hashtag-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

dryRun.description: Validates hashtag parameters without extracting video data or triggering billing charges.
dryRun.title: Dry Run (Validation Mode)

hashtags.description: Add TikTok hashtags to collect information about videos, views, likes, shares, comments, and creators. If not provided, the default hashtag is used.
hashtags.title: Hashtag(s) to scrape from TikTok

proxyConfiguration.description: Select Apify Proxy to ensure high reliability and bypass anti-scraping blocks.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

resultsPerPage.description: Maximum number of posts that will be scraped for each hashtag (1–500). Values outside this range are clamped.
resultsPerPage.title: Max posts per hashtag

name: tiktok_hashtag
